# SS Safety Solutions - Pakistan's Premier Tactical Gear & Safety Equipment Supplier

> Official supplier and distributor of certified tactical gear, self defence gadgets, army store equipment, biometric attendance systems, fire fighting equipment, and industrial personal protective equipment (PPE) in Pakistan. Established in 2010 at 47 Brandreth Road, Lahore, Pakistan.

## Core Categories & Equipment

- **Tactical Gear & Army Store**: Military plate carriers, MOLLE tactical vests, tactical boots, duty belts, and tactical folding pocket knives.
- **Self Defence Gadgets**: Rechargeable police-grade stun guns and high-voltage taser guns with integrated laser sights and safety disable lanyards.
- **Biometric Attendance Systems**: Fingerprint, RFID, and facial recognition attendance machines compatible with official Punjab portal logins and enterprise HR software.
- **Fire Fighting Equipment**: Ductile iron outdoor fire hydrant pillars (BS 750 / NFPA), optical smoke detector sensors (EN 54-7), fire extinguishers (CO2, DCP, Foam), and fire tenders.
- **Safety Footwear & PPE**: Steel-toe safety shoes (EN ISO 20345), tactical ballistic helmets (NIJ IIIA), full-body fall arrest harnesses (ANSI/EN 361), and chemical spill containment kits.
